body.x: AAUXX Korea has presented its new iRing-linked wireless charging system "iRing Charger" in 'South Hall & MIK NIGHT' of CES 2019 held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

This product can charge smartphones wirelessly, maintaining maximum features of iRing. The iRing part can be easily attached and detached, so the users can use it with the iRing intact, then wirelessly charge the phone just by removing the iRing part.
Most of all, it is small enough to be covered by mobile phones, having no burden on the installation in the car and improved portability.

AVING NEWS and GMEG, a global company specializing in MICE have planned together and co-hosted MIK Innovation Hot Spot. MIK Innovation Hot Spot is made as the global project zone to give boost to startups in Korea to enter the global market. With the space provided for exhibition and pitching, it runs various programs and parties. They also hosted their first global network event MIK Innovation Night in Las Vegas.
